name: com.hoonex.solarnet
description: Local-first turn-based multiplayer engine with deterministic recovery, reconnect/process resume, authority checkpoints, and deterministic host-migration planning for Nearby/Bluetooth transports.

samples.description: Two-phone Android diagnostics for Nearby, Bluetooth Classic, room lifecycle, and turn packets.
Playable 5x5 two-player game with local loopback and two-phone Nearby/Bluetooth Classic modes, active-match reconnect, and client process-resume recovery.
